announcement: Sleeping Guddi v0.4.0 brings YouTube Playlist batch downloading, real-time concurrent multi-download queues, and custom folder destination picker!
features: Playlist Batch Studio: Analyze and download entire playlists with 1-click quality presets
Concurrent Queue Drawer: Live parallel multi-download tracking with instant clear controls
Custom Destination Picker: Choose your download folder with quick opening in File Explorer
Format Fallback Engine: Multi-tier fallback hierarchy prevents format unavailability errors
Isolated Temp Cookies: Eliminates Windows file-locking conflicts during parallel downloads
